faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What does a farmhouse interior designer in Chhattarpur do?

We plan living and dining areas, bedrooms, kitchens, verandas and outdoor seating so the farmhouse feels open and connected to the lawns. Materials are chosen to handle heat, dust and heavy use during gatherings.

Can you redesign an old farmhouse?

Yes. Many Chhattarpur farmhouses are older buildings. We update layouts, lighting, kitchens and bathrooms while keeping the parts of the house that still work well.

Why does a weekend farmhouse need specialist design?

A farmhouse interior designer plans for guests, events and long weekends, which needs more storage, durable fabrics and flexible seating than a city flat.

Do you also design outdoor areas and pool decks?

Yes. Verandas, gazebos, pool decks and garden seating are planned together with the interiors, so the indoor and outdoor spaces feel like one home.
